messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences asserting that Sepa Z82 is part of Nato Z5. That is the reverse of 'Nato Z5 is part of Sepa Z82'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Sepa Z82 is part of Nato Z5.
